transports.configuration: The CLI stores the credential once and runtime configuration invokes noeis mcp.
transports.toolDiscovery: Use the MCP tools/list method exposed by the installed server.

transports.authorization: HTTP Bearer Connected-agents token (ntk_at_…). Not OAuth.

authorization.flow: NOEIS browser approval with client-held polling secret

scopeRules.read: Authenticated GET, HEAD, and OPTIONS requests. Reading can expose private workspace material.
scopeRules.agent-write: Authenticated mutations in addition to reads. Individual product routes may impose stricter human-only or approval boundaries.

verification.proves: The tested credential reached the authenticated NOEIS service.
verification.doesNotProve: A runtime loaded MCP tools until that runtime reports discovery and calls connection_info itself.

packageCompatibility.publication: Package publication is a separate release step; inspect installed help before using scoped setup.

taskBoundary.dispatch: Use an explicitly reviewed /a/run task link after connection verification.
